profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full Stack Developer | Cloud Technologist
profile.summary:
Modernizing and innovating tools in a Continuous Integration production environment

Current Work: 
- Building AWS infrastructure to enable Interactive Voice Assistant technology
- Creating observability dashboards using Grafana and using Elasticsearch for log queries
- Contact Center as a Service modernization work using AWS Cloud services
- AWS Cloud Cert in progress 
- Site Reliability Engineering principle application
- UI development using ReactJS
- API development in Python 
- API & UI integration
